title: Three-store external forcing and physical demand memory

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No DUMMY-14 model or tests before DUMMY-13 is formally qualified and the implementation baseline is rebound.

purpose: Add DUMMY-12 rainfall, prescribed root-zone loss and capacity drainage to the DUMMY-13 three-store system while preserving the distinction between internal transfers and external system-boundary terms.
window_order: derive root request R=max(0,W_target-W_root,start) from committed start state
solve surface/groundwater management complementarity for realized irrigation U and reciprocal exchange V
apply the same U to root storage together with prescribed rainfall P and prescribed root loss E
commit root, surface and groundwater endpoint together
derive next request from committed root endpoint only
hypotheses: Irrigation U and surface-groundwater exchange V remain internal transfers and cancel from the combined ledger even after root external forcing is added.
Current management shortage remains diagnostic: rainfall in the same accepted window can eliminate the next request without repaying a backlog state.
Prescribed root-zone loss can make the next physical demand larger than the current management shortage.
Request remains frozen from committed start state; same-window rainfall/loss changes only the next request, not the already issued current request.
Capacity drainage is an explicit external sink from the represented three-store system and therefore remains in the combined ledger rather than cancelling.
For any feasible multi-window forcing sequence, total three-store storage change equals cumulative rainfall minus prescribed root loss minus root capacity drainage.
Two histories with identical committed (W_r,h_s,h_g) have identical next coupling problem regardless of prior shortage diagnostics or prior forcing decomposition.
An infeasible prescribed root loss fails closed before commit and cannot be repaired by silently borrowing water from surface or groundwater.

real_authority_boundary.storage: DUMMY-14 still assumes disjoint dummy stores and cannot close real CSR-B1 storage partition.
real_authority_boundary.drainage: DUMMY-14 capacity drainage is a deliberately owned analytical root-bucket external sink. It must not be mapped onto production drainage or used to close CSR-B2 drainage ownership.
real_authority_boundary.irrigation: DUMMY-12/14 request equations remain analytical surrogates until actual SWAP irrigation-demand authority is bound.

forbidden: no capillary rise or root-groundwater transfer
no production SWAP irrigation equivalence claim
no use of root capacity drainage as production drainage authority
authority_rebind_note: DUMMY-14 preregistration and concept were prepared while DUMMY-13 was pending. No DUMMY-14 implementation occurred then. After DUMMY-13 qualified, the implementation baseline was rebound to this post-qualification head before any DUMMY-14 model or tests were created.
